problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI 00: S2M plane-spread check
problem.question: Does the preexisting synthetic-test plane-spread setting change remaining collapse/drift under uniform full iterative odometry?

next_step: Review the uniform full-sequence experiment; repository extension stays default off.

variants.label: Current fixed reference
variants.intent: Only existing S2M plane-spread acceptance differs:0 vs0.2 copied unchanged from the existing synthetic street test. Same native runner, mapped seed, S2S prior0.03, ground/facadePCA, acceleration; row completion off. No per-sequence adoption or threshold sweep.
variants.command: /workspace/localization-env/inten-facade-pca/pcd_dogfooding dogfooding_results/kitti_seq_00_full experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_00_full_gt.csv --methods inten_loam --summary-json experiments/results/runs/inten_loam_kitti_seq_00_full_map_plane_spread_matrix/baseline/summary.json --no-gt-seed --inten-loam-paper-odometry --input-max-range-m 120 --input-vertical-angle-correction-deg 0.17 --inten-loam-paper-set s2m_plane_max_dist=0.05 --paper-pipeline-accelerated --inten-loam-paper-set s2s_mapped_prior=1 --inten-loam-paper-set s2s_translation_prior_ratio=0.03 --inten-loam-paper-set s2s_ground_pca=1 --inten-loam-paper-set s2s_facade_pca=1 --inten-loam-paper-set s2m_plane_min_spread=0
variants.note: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline (FEF, S2S Alg. 1 with re-association, S2M Alg. 2 with TVF map, DOR gating map insertion); no GT seed. intensity=on mapping=on dor=on mean pairs s2s=1382 s2m=2290 dor points/frame=128; repository acceleration enabled (opt-in, not in the paper); S2S previous mapped-motion seed enabled (repository extension, opt-in); S2S weak-translation prediction prior enabled (repository extension, opt-in); S2S ground PCA normals enabled (repository extension, opt-in); S2S facade PCA normals enabled (repository extension, opt-in); imported full paired experiment; timing is not a standalone speed measurement; actual argv in adjacent native_command.json
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: One candidate setting is evaluated across all sequences. No per-sequence adoption or default selection; the native option remains off.
